name: Big Hole River
blurb: Southwest Montana's salmonfly river. Canyon scenery from Divide to Melrose, then open ranchland.

sections.notes: The canyon section. Maiden Rock is a midway takeout (~6 mi). Sunday nonresident float closures in summer — check FWP.

putInAccess.note: Official BLM coordinate for the Divide Bridge recreation complex with boat-ramp access.

sections.notes: Lower river, more braids. Browne's Bridge is roughly halfway.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Montana FWP Glen Fishing Access Site 39753546
takeOutAccess.note: Boat facility confirmed by current FWP inventory. This agency feature locates the access site, not the ramp edge; it is offset from the river in the agency hydrography. Kept as an approximate facility marker, with no exact take-out bank claim, until ramp-specific coordinates are established.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the signed Glen FAS and follow the site road to the concrete boat ramp; the FWP site marker is inland from the river.

sections.notes: Away from the road. Friday outfitter closure in summer. Watch for rattlesnakes at the takeout.
